Will my customers know they’re talking to an AI?

Most won’t — and most won’t care. Our voice AI uses emotional intelligence technology that laughs, expresses empathy, and adjusts tone naturally. We’ve had customers come into offices asking to meet “Emily” who helped them on the phone. That said, we recommend transparency: the AI can identify itself if asked, and some businesses choose to disclose upfront. The key is that customers get fast, helpful service — that’s what they remember.
What happens if the AI can’t handle a question?

It transfers to your team seamlessly. The AI recognizes when it’s out of its depth and routes the call to a human — with a full summary of the conversation so your staff can pick up without the customer repeating themselves. If no human is available, the AI offers alternatives: scheduling a callback, sending information via text, or taking a detailed message.
How long does setup really take?

3 minutes for the basic agent. Our 1-Click Creator analyzes your website and builds a production-ready AI Receptionist automatically. For deeper customization — special workflows, complex integrations, multi-location routing — our team can implement those within 1-2 weeks depending on complexity. Standard implementation is completely FREE.
Can I keep my current phone number?
Absolutely. We provide a telephony specialist who configures call forwarding from your existing number. Your customers dial the same number they always have — they just get answered now.
What if I need the AI to handle something specific to my business?

Three levels of customization: (1) Simple changes — pricing, hours, services — you do yourself through our dashboard. (2) Workflow changes — conversation flows, integrations — our team handles in hours without coding. (3) Deep customization — complex logic, API connections — our certified engineers implement for enterprise clients. If you can describe it, we can build it.
Is this actually better than hiring a person?

Different, not necessarily “better” — the ideal is both working together. AI handles: unlimited parallel calls, 24/7 coverage, instant response, perfect memory, multilingual support, data analysis. Humans handle: physical presence, complex empathy, relationship building, creative problem-solving. AI costs 1/10th of a human receptionist but generates 20-40% more revenue by capturing leads that would otherwise be lost. The math works.
